Name: Cedar Waxwing - Bombycilla cedrorum
Montana resident in: Summer, winter.
Habitat: Open woodlands, fruiting trees, orchards. Nest is composed of grass and twigs on branch.
Foods: Same as above.
Name: Shrikes - Family Laniidae
Montana resident in: Summer, winter.
Habitat: Semiopen to open country with lookout post available. Nests are well lined cups (bulky) on branch.
Foods: Almost entirely animal life. Large insects, other birds, small' rodents, reptiles.
Miscellaneous: Includes: Loggerhead and Northern Shrikes. Have habit of hanging prey on thorns, cactus spines, or barbed wire.
Name: Starlings - Family Sturnidae
Montana resident in: Summer, winter.
Habitat: Open areas; fields, farm yards, ranches, sparse tree groves, Nest in holes of trees, buildings, etc.
Foods: Insects and varous fruited plants.
Miscellaneous: Introduced species. Usually considered a nuisance because of its gregarious nature.
Name: Vireos - Family Vireonidae
Montana resident in: Summer.
Habitat: Mixed forests, shade trees, groves. Nests are baskets hung from branch.
Foods: Main diet consists of insects, spiders, snails. Also various berries.
Name: Wood Warblers - Family Parulidae
Montana resident in: Summer, migratory only.
Habitat: Most prefer dense conifer forests but some utilize wet areas of streams and marshes. Nests are usually grass or moss cups in low branches or on ground.
Foods: Mainly insectivorous. Consume caterpillars, beetles, wasps, ants, flies, true bugs, plant lice, bees, canderworms, locusts; also spiders.
Name: House (English) Sparrow - Passer domesticus
Montana resident in: Summer, winter.
Habitat: Cities, towns, farms. Nest of various twigs, grass, stings woven into bulky mass.
Foods: Mostly plants. Corn, oats, wheat, ragweed, elm, sunflower, insects.
Miscellaneous: Introduced species. Sometimes dameage crops.
Name: Meadowlarks, Blackbirds, Orioles - Family Icteridae (partial-see below)
Montana resident in: Summer.
